body.estimand_functional: \(\widehat\tau_{t,\ell}=\widehat Q^I_{0t,\ell}-\sum_{j=1}^J\widehat w_{\ell j}\widehat Q_{jt,\ell}\), with \(Q^N_{0t,\ell}=\sum_{j=1}^Jw_{\ell j}Q_{jt,\ell}\), exact finite-array loss \(m_\ell^{-1/2}\Psi^{\mathrm{fin}}_{t,\ell}+n_\ell^{-1}A_{t,\ell}(v_\ell)-2(n_\ell m_\ell)^{-1/2}v_\ell^\top B_{t,\ell}\) plus the three displayed \(\epsilon_{t,\ell}\) terms, and conditional squared-radius calibration \(a_\ell c^*(\eta,\alpha)\)

sampling_model.design: Fixed \(J\), \(T_0\), and \(T_1\) repeated-cross-section distributional synthetic-control panel in which one simplex weight \(w_\ell\) spans the treated no-intervention quantile law in every pre-treatment and post-treatment panel period.
sampling_model.units: The treated and donor cell laws are fixed primitives; each pre cell contributes \(n_\ell\) independent draws and each post cell contributes \(m_\ell\) independent draws.
sampling_model.treatment: Only unit \(j=0\) is intervened upon after period \(T_0\); donor post laws and \(F^I_{0t,\ell}\) are observed, while \(F^N_{0t,\ell}\) is the post-treatment no-intervention counterfactual identified by the same \(w_\ell\) learned from pre-treatment periods.
sampling_model.overlap: No atom-mass lower bound, post-knot separation, interior-weight restriction, or restriction on \(n_\ell/m_\ell\) is imposed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The first \(\lceil n_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\) pre observations and \(\lceil m_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\) post observations in every cell form a deterministic pilot, and the remainder forms an independent main center.  Simultaneous DKW, variance-adaptive multinomial, density, Gram, weight, and covariance regions are combined with exhaustive support, covariance-rank, and simplex-face enumeration and rational Gaussian interval certification.  Within-cell root-\(m_\ell\) mass offsets are learned, including pilot-unseen-mass control; cross-cell translations and root-\(n_\ell\) face offsets remain in the nuisance supremum.  The limiting weight \(w^0\), matrix \(H\), and score covariance \(\Omega\) appear only after local-subsequence extraction.  Sharp-cutoff convergence is proved when every relevant root-scale coordinate is bounded or dominates the pilot uncertainty; global coverage and rate do not require this resolvability condition.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Section~5.3.2 and Proposition~5 provide a published discrete distributional-synthetic-control goodness-of-fit limit; its version-of-record formula was not accessible for a finer claim.

The version-of-record Summary states that counterfactuals are identified by matching treated pre-intervention quantile residuals to a convex combination of control residuals orthogonal to observable common factors.
Section~6.2, Assumptions~4--6, and Corollary~3 give DSC inference for smooth continuous empirical quantiles with a donor-dilution condition.
Theorem~2 gives a convergence rate for DSC weights under interior-weight and quantile-draw conditions.
Theorem~2 transforms simultaneous distribution-function bands into valid bands for discrete quantile functions.
The main theorem gives an asymptotically uniformly valid confidence set for a simplex-valued optimizer weight.
Theorem~1 gives uniformly asymptotically valid conditional critical values with a functional nuisance parameter.
Theorem~1 gives finite-sample validity and size exactness for active-rank Gaussian moment-inequality testing.

body.tldr: Within the maintained exact-fit, common-weight stable-span subclass of discrete distributional synthetic control, the treated unit’s no-intervention quantile law is identified, yielding an exact signed endpoint energy, a constrained weight quadratic, the six-term finite-array decomposition, and three \(n_\ell/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) phase laws. The pre-score limit is explicitly indexed by \(w^0=\lim w_\ell\) and \(\Omega=\lim\Omega_\ell\). Uniformly honest simultaneous \(L^2\) balls attain diameter order \(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4}\), and the conditional Gaussian common cutoff is computable. The proved pilot-split theorem gives a total Borel, globally asymptotically uniformly honest, rate-optimal rule using exhaustive support, covariance-rank, and face enumeration, rational interval certification, explicit error budgets, and finite work. Its normalized squared radius attains \(c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) only under the stated bounded-or-well-separated pilot-resolvability dichotomy: bounded cross-cell translations and face offsets remain in the nuisance supremum, while within-cell root-\(m_\ell\) masses are learned. Full all-strata attainment by another raw-sample construction remains open; the present sublinear pilots cannot attain stratum-specific cutoffs on slowly diverging face or cross-cell diagonals because their root-scale uncertainties are \(n_\ell^{1/8}\) and \(m_\ell^{1/8}\). Oracle reduction is claimed only under quantitatively pilot-resolvable separation and interiority with a continuous nondegenerate critical law. The Bernoulli bracket \(1.913<c_B^*\leq1.914\), versus collision oracle \(1.38590382435\), is the certified honesty penalty.

project_justification.gap: Chen supplies residual-matching DSC, Gunsilius supplies the quantile-span model and discrete asymptotics, Alvarez--Orestes supplies continuous-cell quantile-mixture inference, and the cited conditional and active-set papers supply separate calibration ingredients.  No located result proves a measurable uniformly honest raw-sample radius that combines atomic endpoint conditioning, estimated simplex-face weights, changing support and covariance rank, nuisance-exclusion budgeting, and sharp conditional-cutoff attainment on pilot-unresolvable diagonal arrays.
project_justification.niche: Fixed donors, independent pre and post cell samples, one exact stable span weight, smooth pre laws with finite-array curvature, and unrestricted finite post supports produce a two-scale endpoint--face experiment.  The limiting weight \(w^0\) and pre-score covariance \(\Omega\) are extracted with the knot and phase coordinates.  Within-cell masses of order \(m_\ell^{-1/2}\) are pilot-learnable, while cross-cell translations and root-\(n_\ell\) face offsets are not; quantitative pilot resolvability separates the regimes where certified sharp convergence is proved from the diagonal obstruction.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the exact expansion and phase laws, optimal-rate honest DKW balls, the Bernoulli honesty penalty, the deterministic conditional-cutoff calculation, a uniform triangular pre-score linearization, and one total measurable finite-work certified radius with global honesty and sharp-cutoff convergence on explicitly pilot-resolvable regimes.  It does not relabel that partial attainment as a solution of the all-strata OEQ: overcoming the slowly diverging pilot-resolution obstruction remains the same-topic open theorem.

body.related_work: Chen's Journal of Applied Econometrics article identifies counterfactuals through pre-intervention quantile-residual matching, while Gunsilius establishes the Wasserstein-quantile DSC model and a discrete goodness-of-fit limit.  Alvarez and Orestes treat smooth continuous empirical quantiles with regularization and donor dilution; Zhang, Zhang, and Zhang study prediction and weight rates under quantile-grid and interior-weight conditions.  Sommerfeld and Munk supply finite-space Wasserstein limits, Chernozhukov, Fernandez-Val, Melly, and Wuthrich supply honest inversion of distribution bands for discrete quantiles, Andrews supplies boundary extremum asymptotics, and Canen and Song supply simplex-weight inference.  Andrews and Mikusheva and Cox and Shi provide conditional and active-set ingredients.  None of these cited works gives the present measurable raw-to-Gaussian pilot-split radius with exhaustive changing-support, rank, and face enumeration, nor do they overcome the proved slowly diverging pilot-resolution obstruction.  Zhai et al. remain the same-question abundance-QTE consumer; their separate binary CDF and \(W_1\) elimination analysis is outside scope.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The local criterion minimizes a common deterministic conditional squared-radius cutoff over \(\mathscr C_\eta\); it does not optimize expected radius, randomized rules, or arbitrary observation-dependent radii.  The finite Gaussian object is a conditional loss experiment, not unrestricted deficiency equivalence for the raw samples.  The total pilot-split radius is globally uniformly honest and rate-optimal, but convergence to \(c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) is proved only under the stated pilot-resolvability dichotomy.  Slowly diverging cross-cell translations or face offsets can be grouped conservatively for coverage yet remain pilot-indistinguishable from collisions or boundaries, so all-strata sharp attainment remains open.  Oracle calibration requires fixed unscaled knot separation, weights bounded away from every face, and a continuous nondegenerate critical law.  Applying the result to Zhai et al. additionally requires a bridge for discrete pre outcomes, beta-weighted fitting, aggregation, dependence, and interpolation.
body.honest_scope: The exact endpoint identity, exact six-term expansion, pulse-sharp cross-vector limit, local compactification, triangular pre-score linearization with \(w^0\) and \(\Omega\), three phase laws, degeneracy criteria, honest optimal diameter order, Bernoulli honesty penalty, deterministic common cutoff, and pilot-resolvable certified calibration theorem are proved.  The stable-span assumption identifies \(Q^N_{0t,\ell}\); it never equates the counterfactual with \(Q^I_{0t,\ell}\).  The certified radius is total, Borel, globally asymptotically honest, and rate-optimal.  It learns within-cell local masses, retains bounded cross-cell translations and face offsets as nuisance, and attains the common cutoff when every root-scale coordinate is bounded or exceeds the quantitative pilot-resolution threshold.  A \(J=2\), \(S=3\) bounded-offset stress test verifies these claims but is not evidence for all-strata convergence.  The slowly diverging diagonal obstruction leaves full feasible sharp calibration open.  Oracle reduction is restricted to fixed separated interior strata with continuous nondegenerate critical law, and no adaptation to the smaller collision-oracle cutoff is claimed.
